title: Open a cold call in 20 seconds
prompt: You're calling a small business owner you've never spoken to about your service. Open the call.
target_behavior: Say why you're calling in your first sentence.
tips: Then ask for thirty seconds of their time.
Make it about their problem, not your product.

feedback.headline: The target showed up in your answer — nice.

where.quote: Okay, so the short version: I help a team of twelve ship our app every two weeks.

what_worked: You kept it specific and easy to follow.
feedback.one_change: Try it once more and open with your main point.
